lines.1: 「At this rate, aren't we going to have a water shortage this year?」
lines.3: I still hadn't fully recovered from the fatigue, but I had one more push in me.
lines.4: Day three of coming to school during the holiday.
lines.6: She was standing frozen in front of the gate.
lines.8: 「What's wrong? I feel like I saw that exact face yesterday.」
lines.12: There was a huge amount of dirt and dust caked onto it.
lines.13: 「No way. It couldn't get like this in a single night.」
lines.15: 「And it's sticky with oil... This is worse than before.」
lines.17: 「If this didn't happen naturally, there's only one explanation.」
lines.21: 「Damn it! We worked so hard to get it clean!!」
lines.22: 「I helped with the second half, so yeah. I know how you feel.」
lines.23: What a rotten thing to do.
lines.24: 「...So what do we do with this?」
lines.25: 「...Clean it again! What else can we do!?」
lines.26: 「It looked similar when you came in yesterday morning too, right?」
lines.27: 「Which means even if we clean it again...」
lines.28: 「I know what you're saying, but I took responsibility for this. I have to do it.」
lines.29: 「Maybe this time I'll keep watch, catch whoever it is.」
lines.31: They might not even wait until night. They could dirty the gate the moment Konoe looked away.
lines.32: That was how deliberately malicious this mess felt.
lines.34: 「You going to tell everyone about this?」
lines.35: 「The gate was a problem I volunteered us for... I need to handle it myself.」
lines.36: 「I don't want to make everyone worry about something extra right now.」
lines.38: There she goes into justice mode again.
lines.39: I've told her not to keep herself wound so tight.
lines.40: Guess I'll have to back her up.
lines.41: I did make that promise to Otome, after all.
